cleanup.instructions: 只在正式驗收或明確取消後執行，先查其他卡依賴並保存回讀；本契約不授權自動清理。 Engineer marks only reports identified QA452 as closed after PM completion; do not disable account or delete unrelated reports

rebuild.instructions: 既有步驟仍需核對版本/權限/資料歸屬，不自動執行。 Reopen page or 再回報一則 to blank form; wait documented rate-limit window rather than flood; test records remain tagged
